name: Last Third of Night (Tahajjud)
desc: The Lord descends to the nearest heaven
hadith: Our Lord descends every night to the lowest heaven when one-third of the night remains, saying: Who calls upon Me that I may answer him?

name: In Sujood (Prostration)
desc: Nearest a servant is to Allah
hadith: The nearest a servant comes to his Lord is when he is prostrating, so make abundant supplication during prostration.

name: Between Adhan & Iqamah
hadith: A supplication made between the Adhan and the Iqamah is not rejected.

name: Friday Pre-Maghrib Hour
hadith: On Friday there is an hour in which no Muslim servant asks Allah for good except that He gives it to him.

name: During Downpour / Rain
hadith: Two supplications are not rejected: during the call to prayer and under the rain.

name: Acute Distress / Anxiety
hadith: Call upon Allah when you are certain of response, knowing Allah does not answer a heedless heart.
